top_story.headline: Lobbying firm reports contacting the Pardon Office for a client
top_story.dek: Mintz Levin's third-quarter report describes July and August communications with the Pardon Office on behalf of Abdeslam Jaidi.
paragraphs: Mintz Levin Cohn Ferris Glovsky and Popeo, P.C. reported $20,000 in lobbying income from Abdeslam Jaidi in its third-quarter Lobbying Disclosure Act report. The issue description says the firm communicated with the Pardon Office in July, submitting information from an application form the office had sent, and in August asked a question about a listing on the office's official website. Peter Chavkin is the named lobbyist.
It was the only new filing this window that mentions pardons or clemency.

sections.headline: 45 new lobbying registrations, led by BGR Government Affairs in defense tech, crypto and finance
paragraphs: Between October 8 and the morning of October 9, 2026, the Senate Lobbying Disclosure Act database posted 649 filings, of which 45 are new registrations; the rest are mostly third-quarter activity reports and amendments. Every new registration is listed below, with the firm linked to its filing.

Several fall in areas covered elsewhere today: BGR Government Affairs signed Air Space Intelligence and Krateosky LLC, and Checkmate Government Relations signed Nexo AG (see Industries to Watch). Invariant LLC registered for Hyperliquid Policy Center on agricultural commodity markets.
